question.text: Which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: Proteins are polyamides formed from amino acids
Except glycine, all other amino acids show optical activity
Natural proteins are commonly made up of L-isomer of amino acids

In <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></math> -amino acids, <math><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> groups are attached to different carbon atoms

solution.text: In α -amino acids, -NH2 and -COOH groups are attached to the same carbon atoms,  .
